Segment Name: Olentangy River Water Trail — Section A
Description: Quieter, more natural experience; flows mainly through wooded parkland. No low-head dams — ideal for uninterrupted paddling.
Identity Notes: Named section per official Columbus Rec Parks page. Parent trail: Olentangy River Water Trail.

Segment Name: Olentangy River Water Trail — Section B
Description: Section B contains three lowhead dams that must be portaged for safety: North Broadway Dam, Union Cemetery Dam, and Dodridge Street Dam. Features interesting scenery including Union Cemetery and OSU Wetlands. Paddlers should be prepared to carry canoe or kayak for several hundred yards at each portage point.

Segment Name: Olentangy River Water Trail — Section C
Description: Urban section of the trail passing OSU Campus, Ohio Stadium, and offering views of downtown Columbus. No lowhead dam hazards. Ends at Lower Olentangy Boat Launch at the confluence with the Scioto River.
